$comment: Ledger of every place Forward's build differs from upstream file content.
replaced: upstream pxt-microbit files that forward/overlay/files replaces. apply-overlay.js fails if the upstream file's SHA-256 no longer matches, so someone re-checks the replacement.
overridden: pxt-core files (from the npm package) that a same-named file in the target's docfiles/ overrides. check-invariants.js checks them after npm install.
Hashes are for pxt-microbit v9.0.12 and pxt-core 13.0.9.

docfiles/apptrackingweb.html.why: Drops the Usabilla survey embed; keeps the pxtweb.js script the editor needs.

docfiles/tracking.html.why: Removes Application Insights from documentation pages; keeps pxtweb.js.

docfiles/apptracking.html.why: Removes Application Insights from the editor.

docfiles/tickevent.html.why: Stops the once-a-second poll for Application Insights.
